scope: Single-assistant ordinal art review of whole-stage Q6 contact sheets (175 actual native frames); Q7 fixes renderer ownership without changing artwork. Not a human panel or an animation-quality study.
scale: 0 missing/broken;1 prototype;2 crude;3 coherent development art;4 polished authored craft;5 exceptional. Ties are not wins.
